== Title ==
<span lang="ja">司令官の責任</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">2フォース消費して反乱軍基地の戦略司令室／戦闘指揮所上に配備する。没収値＞4の反乱軍か相手のリーダーを目標とする。相手は目標のいる場所では、戦闘を宣言できずフォース消耗も行なえない。目標がウーティーニー・エフェクトに到達したならウーティーニー・エフェクトはキャンセルされる。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">「本部所属の者は、司令センターに報告を行なえ」</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — Responsibility Of Command.

'''Lore''' — “Headquarters personnel, report to the command center.”

'''Game text''' — Spend 2 Force to deploy to the strategy room or battle command post of a Rebel base. Target a Rebel with forfeit greater than 4 or one of the opponent’s leaders. The opponent cannot initiate a battle or Force drain where the target is. Cancel the Effect when the target reaches it.

The original English names any war room at a Rebel Base. The Japanese uses the paired terms 戦略司令室／戦闘指揮所. Both print the same forfeit threshold.<ref>[[:File:Hoth-D-responsibilityofcommand-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[Responsibility Of Command]].</ref>
